name: io.traql/mcp-server
title: traql
description: AML risk scoring for crypto addresses and transactions on Ethereum, BSC, TRON, TON, Bitcoin

environmentVariables.name: TRAQL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from https://app.traql.io. Without it the server runs on the keyless tier: a coarse verdict, 3 free checks per IP per day, then payment-gated on the hosted API.

environmentVariables.name: TRAQL_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the traql API. Override only when self-hosting.
